## Checklist
- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and followed the project guardrails in `.grok/AGENTS.md` (Arjan Codes + OWASP).

- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works (`uv run --extra test pytest`).
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes.
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published.
- [ ] I have updated the version in `pyproject.toml`, `src/linfo/__init__.py`, and `CITATION.cff` (if this is a release).
- [ ] I have updated `CHANGELOG.md` with a clear entry under the appropriate version.
